description_en: Queries the binding relationship between a specific dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
description_zh: 查询指定的数据集和对象存储（OSS）Bucket绑定关系详情
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-binding --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-dataset --uri oss://test-bucket --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBinding

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. You can obtain the name of the project from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html operation
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. You can obtain the name of the dataset from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en:
The URI of the OSS bucket to which you bind the dataset.

Specify the value in the oss\://${Bucket} format. `${Bucket}` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project
parameters.help_zh:
数据集绑定的对象存储（OSS） Bucket URI。

对象存储（OSS） Bucket URI 的格式为oss://${Bucket}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一地域的 OSS Bucket 名称
parameters.name: uri
